title: VOD Search Category Routing, Playback Stall Fix & Full App Restart
releaseNotes:
• Live TV Search Bar Focus: Cleaned up Live TV search bar on focus by removing the redundant 'OK TO SEARCH' badge for a cleaner, modern look
• Preview Space Channel Location: Removed category badges from channel list items in search results; category location is now cleanly presented strictly in the preview info space below the live player
• VOD Search Category Navigation: Selecting any Movie or Series search result navigates directly to that item's parent category, automatically scrolling and focusing the title within its category as if navigated manually
• Continuous VOD Playback Fix: Resolved mid-stream pausing and stalling on titles like 'The Drop: A Snowfall Saga' (Hulu/FX/Fox/ABC) and high-bitrate series by eliminating socket read timeouts, adding Matroska MKV detection, and enabling dynamic hardware AudioCapabilities passthrough
• Guaranteed Full System Reboot: Replaced immediate process exit with scheduled AlarmManager PendingIntent execution and affinity termination for a guaranteed 100% full OS-level app restart
• Strict Quad-Portal Lock: Locked strictly to the 4 approved server portals (vpn.uhdp.top, tv.wd.uhdp.top, vpn.uhd4.top, tv.wd.uhd4.top) with zero references or fallbacks to unauthorized domains
• Password Visibility Toggle: Added eye toggle button to view entered passwords in Settings and authentication dialogs
• Streamlined Navigation: Retired the temporary Now Playing module to deliver a lightning-fast, rock-solid core entertainment experience
